prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” roofer, but **Red Hawk Roofing** looks like a strong option for Denver hail damage: it specializes in storm restoration, says it is licensed and insured, and reports 4.9 stars from 290+ Google reviews. It also advertises a five-year workmanship warranty. [Red Hawk Roofing](https://redhawkroofing.com/)

I’d get at least two more written estimates before choosing. **Gates Enterprises** is another hail-focused option, and **Cenco Roofing** advertises Colorado licensing and insurance plus GAF Master Elite and Owens Corning Platinum Preferred credentials. [Gates](https://www.gatesroof.com/areas/denver) · [Cenco](https://www.cencoroofing.com/locations/denver/storm-damage/)

Before signing, verify the contractor’s current local license and insurance, ask for recent references, and get the scope, materials, warranty, and payment schedule in writing. Be cautious of anyone pressuring you to sign immediately or promising to cover your insurance deductible.
